value.rationale: An exact complete classification of every output of the curling transform at the natural, published extremal ternary boundary; 6048 source words collapse to only two images. The newly verified all-or-none extension property at length 83 explains the 2:1 fiber split and determines which admissible prefixes survive to maximal length. This gives the precise reconstruction ambiguity of a natural transform under strong combinatorial constraints, rather than a routine restatement of the known maximal length or an arbitrary parameter slice.
